description: Significant Coastal Fish and Wildlife Habitats (SCFWH) in the Town. The [NYS Department of State](https://dos.ny.gov/significant-coastal-fish-wildlife-habitats) designates these habitats and publishes a narrative for each one. [LWRP Section III](https://docs.dos.ny.gov/opd-lwrp/LWRP/East%20Hampton_T/Original/LWRP/Section%20III.pdf) lists sixteen State habitats in the Town and five habitats that the Town designated as locally significant. Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the column meanings and tested queries.

table:columns.description: State habitat code, for example EH-3. The value is 0 for a locally significant habitat.

table:columns.description: Area in square feet, as the Town computed it.
